command:
set -eu
sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/secure-volume
sudo -n fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n sh -c 'umask 077; dd if=/dev/urandom of=/var/lib/secure-volume/key bs=64 count=1 2>/dev/null'
sudo -n chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks1 --key-file /var/lib/secure-volume/key /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n cryptsetup isLuks /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n stat -c 'BACKING=%n SIZE=%s MODE=%a OWNER=%U:%G' /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo -n stat -c 'KEY=%n SIZE=%s MODE=%a OWNER=%U:%G' /var/lib/secure-volume/key

command:
set -eu
sudo -n cryptsetup open --type luks --key-file /var/lib/secure-volume/key /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img secure_crypt
sudo -n mkfs.ext4 -q -L secure_data /dev/mapper/secure_crypt
sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /srv/secure
sudo -n mount /dev/mapper/secure_crypt /srv/secure
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "encrypted-volume-ready" > /srv/secure/persistence-proof.txt'
sudo -n chmod 0600 /srv/secure/persistence-proof.txt
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
sudo -n cryptsetup status secure_crypt
sudo -n cat /srv/secure/persistence-proof.txt
